items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: played Michael’s Pub with him for a month in New York. And we recorded in Tokyo. That was a great experience working with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. I traveled with him too, to Japan, and played Michael’s Pub with him for a month in New York. And we recorded in Tokyo. That was a great experience working with him. He wasn’t that generous with the money but musically it was most gratifying. I enjoyed that.
Maybe he learned that from Benny Goodman.
